title: Direction of thermal energy flow in a reaction
body: In an exothermic reaction (negative enthalpy change), thermal energy flows from the system to the surroundings; in an endothermic reaction (positive enthalpy change), it flows from the surroundings to the system.
ced_evidence: 6.6.A.2 "Thermal energy is transferred to the surroundings as the reactants convert to products in an exothermic reaction. Thermal energy is transferred from the surroundings as the reactants convert to products in an endothermic reaction."
